matter.description: Sapini v. Harlow, motor vehicle collision

notes.subject: Intake
notes.detail: Client rear-ended at a red light on March 9, 2026. Complains of right shoulder and neck pain. Police report requested.

notes.subject: Call with adjuster
notes.detail: Call with adjuster at Harbor Mutual. Adjuster stated the policy limit is $50,000 per person. Asked for the declarations page in writing.

notes.subject: Surgery recommended
notes.detail: Dr. McCulloch recommends arthroscopic shoulder surgery. Demand cannot go out until surgery is done and final bills are in.

notes.subject: Call to McCulloch office
notes.detail: Called McCulloch's office about the surgery date. Front desk says they are waiting for the client to call and schedule.

notes.subject: Call with client
notes.detail: Spoke with client. He says he will schedule the surgery whenever the office calls him; nobody has called.

notes.subject: Lien status
notes.detail: Health plan lien amount still unconfirmed. Lien letter says $6,400 but the plan has not sent the itemization.

communications.subject: Request for surgery date and updated records
communications.body: Please send the scheduled surgery date and updated treatment records for our client.

communications.subject: Second request: surgery date, records and billing
communications.body: Second request: please confirm the surgery date and send updated records and billing.

communications.subject: Client check-in
communications.body: Client called. Still attending physical therapy twice a week, last session September 22.

communications.subject: Billing ledger request
communications.body: Please send the billing ledger through August.

communications.subject: Acknowledgment of representation
communications.body: We acknowledge your letter of representation. Coverage review is ongoing.
